description: This PHP script generates a printer-friendly view for a specific requirement in the TestLink project. It initializes page settings, retrieves requirement data, and renders the requirement details in HTML format.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP object used to store GUI data such as object name, page title, and requirement identifiers.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class responsible for handling hierarchical structure of the requirements in the system.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments related to requirement ID, version, and revision, also retrieves test project info from session.
